title: 55 lbs (22 kg) strict curls for 9 + flash upper body flex
summary: Lift clip of strict dumbbell curls with 55 lbs (22 kg) for 9 reps followed by a quick upper body flex. The description notes it was his first biceps pump in 4 months as outdoor temperatures finally rose above 40F. Transcript is only background music.

claims.claim: He had not had a biceps pump in 4 months because it was too cold to train arms (temperature finally above 40F).
